doc.name: Unitrader
doc.instructions: Unitrader is an AI trading assistant that works on a person's own brokerage account, with their rules. Use these tools to explain what Unitrader is, how it works and what it costs, to share what its AI did across the platform today, to teach trading ideas plainly, and to point people to unitrader.ai to start. They are information only: they cannot trade, see anyone's account or recommend a market. Never present anything from them as advice to buy or sell; always pass on that capital is at risk.

tools.name: about_unitrader
tools.title: About Unitrader
tools.description: What Unitrader is, how its AI trader works on a person's own brokerage account, its built-in safety rules, the three ways to use it, and the plans and prices.

tools.name: ai_activity_today
tools.title: What Unitrader's AI did today
tools.description: How many market checks Unitrader's AI made across all accounts in the last 24 hours, how often it chose to wait, how many trade ideas its risk rules held back, and how many trades it placed. Platform-wide counts only: no markets, accounts or people.

tools.name: trading_lesson
tools.title: Trading lesson
tools.description: A short, plain-English lesson on a trading idea (for example stop-losses, spreads, position size, leverage, order types) or on how Unitrader handles it. Education only, never a recommendation. Leave the topic out to list the lessons.

topic.description: What to explain, e.g. "stop-loss" or "why wait". Optional.

tools.name: get_started
tools.title: Get started with Unitrader
tools.description: How to start using Unitrader, beginning free with practice money, and the link to sign up.
